fixtures.prompt: Explain one practical way to improve a team handoff.
fixtures.transcript: The office kitchen needs a schedule. I bought a bicycle last year. Before deciding, the deadline changed. A checklist could help, but the handoff is the main point, and that is all.

structure_failures.observation: The ideas do not follow a useful order.
